env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# logos help eject states the go directive rule the eject writer
# applies and allows DIR inside the source tree. It must not claim that
# every ejected tree builds with Go 1.27.2 or that eject never writes
# into the source tree.
logos help eject
stdout 'DIR/go.mod keeps the go'
stdout 'directive of the main module, which logos mod init sets to the'
stdout 'satisfies every go directive in it'
stdout 'Eject leaves the source tree unchanged apart from DIR,'
stdout 'which may lie inside it'
! stdout '1\.27\.2 or newer toolchain'
! stdout 'never writes'

# The rule the help states: DIR/go.mod and the support module keep the
# main module's go directive, and DIR lies inside the module here.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^5$'
logos eject -o out
grep '^go 1\.27\.3$' out/go.mod
grep '^go 1\.27\.3$' out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
! exists out/out
cd out
go run .
stdout '^5$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejecthelp

go 1.27.3
-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func reader() *strings.Reader {
	return strings.NewReader("hello")
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(reader().Len())
}
